command:
import json,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);workers=json.loads((root/'launch.json').read_text())['workers']
while True:
 pending=[]
 for case,row in workers.items():
  if (root/'cases'/case/'completion.json').exists():continue
  stat=Path('/proc',str(row['pid']),'stat')
  if not stat.exists() or stat.read_text().split()[2]=='Z':
   (root/'readback-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='worker_failed',case=case)))
   raise SystemExit(1)
  pending.append(case)
 (root/'readback-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='waiting' if pending else 'analyzing',pending=pending)))
 if not pending:break
 time.sleep(30)
command=[sys.executable,'-m','tools.audit_cold_service_gate','--root',str(root),'--output',str(root/'independent-readback.json')]
result=subprocess.run(command)
(root/'readback-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='complete' if result.returncode==0 else 'readback_failed',exit_code=result.returncode)))
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
